Dependencies are intentionally not vendored yet.

Intended future third-party stack:
- Vulkan SDK
- volk
- VMA
- SDL3
- Slang
- Dear ImGui docking branch
- GLM
- spdlog
- Tracy
- EnTT
- fastgltf
- stb_image
